ext.description: A pixel-art pet that lives in a panel of your editor: a capybara by its lake, or an Andean condor soaring over the Illimani. It reacts as you code — runs while you type, celebrates commits and passing tests, gets scared by errors, takes breaks and sleeps.
cmd.show.title: Show the Capybara
cmd.pet.title: Pet the Capybara
cmd.switchPet.title: Switch Pet (Capybara ↔ Condor)
cmd.swim.title: Go for a Swim
cmd.feed.title: Feed the Capybara
cmd.toggle.title: Show/Hide the Capybara
config.enabled.desc: Show your pet. Turn it off to hide it without uninstalling (or run *Capibara Pet: Show/Hide*).
config.pet.capybara.label: Capybara
config.pet.condor.label: Andean condor
config.pet.capybara.desc: A capybara in its wetland by the lake — it walks, swims, has a baby and loves watermelon.
config.pet.condor.desc: An Andean condor over the Illimani and La Paz — finer pixel art; it soars, perches on its rock and sunbathes.
config.pet.desc: Your pet. Each one lives in its own habitat.
config.name.desc: A name for your pet, shown on hover and in the status bar.
config.size.desc: Size of your pet, in pixels (40–160). `84` keeps the pixel art perfectly crisp for both pets; for the capybara, any multiple of 42 does too.
config.speed.desc: Movement speed multiplier — walking and running for the capybara, flying for the condor (`1` = normal).
config.background.time.label: Follow the time of day
config.background.scene.label: Always day
config.background.sunset.label: Always sunset
config.background.night.label: Always night
config.background.auto.label: Day or night by theme
config.background.solid.label: Solid colour
config.background.transparent.label: Transparent
config.background.time.desc: The scenery follows your clock: dawn, day, sunset and night, changing by itself.
config.background.night.desc: The scenery at night, under the stars and the real moon.
config.background.auto.desc: Day with a light editor theme, night with a dark one.
config.background.solid.desc: No scenery: the editor theme's panel colour.
config.background.transparent.desc: No scenery and no background: your pet blends into the panel.
config.background.desc: What's behind your pet. The scenery is its habitat: the lake for the capybara, the Illimani over La Paz for the condor.
config.weather.auto.label: Automatic
config.weather.clear.label: Clear
config.weather.cloudy.label: Cloudy
config.weather.rain.label: Rain
config.weather.storm.label: Storm
config.weather.fog.label: Fog
config.weather.snow.label: Snow
config.weather.auto.desc: Changes by itself every few hours: mostly clear, sometimes cloudy, rain, a storm or morning fog — and snow in winter.
config.weather.cloudy.desc: Overcast: more clouds, a greyer sky.
config.weather.storm.desc: Heavy rain with the odd flash of lightning.
config.weather.fog.desc: Banks of fog drifting through the valley.
config.weather.snow.desc: Falling snow and white slopes (the lake freezes: no swimming).
config.weather.desc: The scenery's weather. Only with the scenery backgrounds.
config.seasons.desc: Seasonal touches (spring blossoms, autumn leaves, winter colours) and holiday surprises (Halloween, Christmas, New Year).
config.hemisphere.auto.label: Automatic
config.hemisphere.north.label: Northern
config.hemisphere.south.label: Southern
config.hemisphere.south.desc: Southern hemisphere: the seasons are flipped and the moon is seen mirrored.
config.hemisphere.desc: Your hemisphere, for the seasons and how the moon looks.
config.coffeeAfterSeconds.desc: Idle seconds before your pet takes a break: a coffee or a swim for the capybara, sunbathing on its rock for the condor.
config.sleepAfterSeconds.desc: Idle seconds before your pet falls asleep.
config.bubbles.desc: Show little speech bubbles (saving, sleeping, petting…).
config.sounds.desc: Tiny 8-bit sound effects (petting, splashes, commits and tests, birds, thunder…). They start after your first click in the panel.
config.statusBar.desc: Show a status bar item (🦫 or 🦅) that mirrors your pet's mood; hover it for the weather and the season.
config.reactToErrors.desc: Your pet gets scared when the active file has errors.
config.reactToDebug.desc: Your pet celebrates when a debug session starts.
config.reactToGit.desc: Your pet reacts to Git: it celebrates commits and pushes, gets scared by merge conflicts and hops when you switch branch.
config.reactToTasks.desc: Your pet reacts to build and test results — tasks, and commands like `npm test` or `cargo build` in the integrated terminal: it celebrates when they pass and gets scared when they fail.
config.color.classic.label: Classic
config.color.chocolate.label: Chocolate
config.color.golden.label: Golden
config.color.cream.label: Cream
config.color.ash.label: Ash
config.baby.desc: Your pet's little one: a baby capybara that follows yours around (and rides on its back when it swims), or the condor's chick waiting in its nest on the rock.
